---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a self-hosting improvement, new chain, or DEX adapter
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem are you trying to solve?

A clear description of the user-facing problem. "I want X" is less useful than "When I try to do Y, the bot does Z".

## Proposed solution

What you would like the bot or web app to do. Include the chain, DEX, and protocol family if relevant.

## Cost / risk considerations

Would the change require new RPC calls, Blockscout calls, or background work? If so, roughly how often, and is it opt-in?

## Alternatives considered

Anything you tried first that did not work.

## Additional context

Links to factory addresses, PoolManager addresses, ABI references, or example transactions, with addresses redacted only if they are private.
